summary: Cheer Holding, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its notice and proxy statement for the 2026 annual general meeting to be held on July 7, 2026, at its Beijing offices. The filing serves routine corporate governance purposes, soliciting proxies for shareholder votes on ordinary matters; no special transaction such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is described. As a foreign private issuer, Cheer uses Form 6-K to furnish the proxy materials. The record date is June 15, 2026, and shareholders may vote by proxy or in person.
